preconditions.description: The size of the permutation n is between 1 and 300000 inclusive.
The length of the permutation list is equal to n.
The permutation contains all integers from 1 to n exactly once.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(a < (x / y) < b for a, x, y, b in zip(permutation, permutation[1:], permutation[2:], permutation[3:])) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if there exists a pair of integers a, b such that a < (x / y) < b in the permutation, otherwise 'NO'.
